extracted.name: Milk Toast
extracted.description: This old-fashioned breakfast recipe for milk toast combines bite-sized toasted white bread pieces served in a bowl of sweetened, vanilla-flavored milk.
ingredient_lines: 3 pinches ground cinnamon, or to taste
instruction_lines: Combine milk, sugar, and vanilla extract in a medium saucepan over medium heat; bring to a boil. Divide milk among 3 bowls.
Tear toast into bite-sized pieces; divide among bowls. Sprinkle with cinnamon.
